description.html:
Disclaimer: Slight colour variations are possible due
to photographic lighting or your monitor settings.

Product Details:

  • Exhibit a vibe of elegance with this classic three-piece suit from Kora.
  • The set comes with a royal cobalt blue embellished blazer, contrast white shirt and a black waist coat along with a classic black trouser, that is fashioned from premium quality material and is tailored for a slim fit.
  • The blazer is tailored to perfection in terry rayon fabric.
  • The abstract stripped embroidery in sequin and cutdana add charm to the blazer.
  • The lapel is tailored in contrast black blended fabric for a classy look.
  • The set comes with a black terry rayon waist coat.
  • The white shirt featuring is a timeless one which can never go wrong for a cocktail event.
  • The set comes with a solid black trouser tailored in straight fit crafted in terry rayon fabric.
  • The tuxedo looks great with a embellished band with a bow.
  • Accessorize the outfit with black suede shoes.
